players.product: enterprise PCIe Gen5 SSD controllers for hyperscaler SSDs

quarterly_data.signal: Correction filing (filed 2026-08-07) to the 2026-06-26 disclosure of the enterprise SSD controller supply contract with an undisclosed overseas NAND flash memory manufacturer (related filings 2026-02-12 and 2026-06-26; PO received 2026-02-12; term 2026-02-12 to 2026-08-07; outsourced production, overseas supply; 10% advance of USD 1,406,000 received on 2025-12-02; payment by the Friday of the week after delivery): the disclosure-deferral deadline of 2026-08-07 was removed and the contract term ended with the product payment fully received as of the filing date. The counterparty's name, revenue and relationship stay withheld at its request for trade secrecy.
quarterly_data.figure: USD 14,060,000 (KRW 20,448,864,000), 47.01% of 2024 consolidated revenue; payment fully received
